correctness.rationale: For arbitrary finite fields and all n>=2, normalized rank-one outer products reduce both opposite products to two cross-evaluations. Exhaustive case separation proves necessity. Explicit q-1-parameter reconstruction proves sufficiency for every compatible nonzero pair. Independent projective-incidence counts give the exact one-sided and zero fibers, the nonzero target population H and total N^2 mass. Direct literal multiplication corroborated seven prime-field configurations; it is not the source of the unbounded proof.

value.rationale: The joint image and all individual fibers of the natural two-sided multiplication map on one nonzero nilpotent orbit are classified in every dimension and finite characteristic. The theorem provides a constructive q-1 torsor for compatible nonzero opposite-product targets, exact output population, a consistency mass identity and the simultaneous Jordan–Lie coupling. These are not determined by known univariate marginal counts, and the invariant is motivated by factorization and noncommutative order sensitivity rather than an arbitrary finite sample.
